daily.topThemeTitle: Interoperability and Quality Frameworks Keep Advancing Across Organizations
daily.topThemeBody: 1EdTech's 2026 trend-watch keeps pointing toward governed, interoperable ecosystems over standalone tools, Ed-Fi's impact-story library keeps making the real-time-data case, and a five-quality-indicators framework from 1EdTech, ISTE, CoSN, CAST and SETDA is giving districts a shared rubric for vetting edtech and AI purchases.

heroWeek.themeTitle: Fall Conference Calendar Fills In From a Sept. 23 Virtual Kickoff to EDUCAUSE
heroWeek.themeBody: The virtual Tech Tactics in Education opens September 23, EDUCAUSE's annual conference follows September 29, 1EdTech's CBExchange runs September 30-October 3, and ISTE has opened proposals for ISTELive 27 in Boston -- all ahead of EdTech Week's October return to Columbia.
